title: Eng ko‘p uchraydigan C1 xatolari
goal_uz: Dars oxirida o‘zbek tilida so‘zlashuvchilarda C1 darajasida ham saqlanib qoladigan grammatik, hamroh so‘z, predlog va uslub xatolarini taniysiz va to‘rt bosqichli tekshirish ro‘yxati yordamida qisqa matndagi kamida oltita xatoni mustaqil topib tuzatasiz.

scenes.title: Eng ko‘p uchraydigan xatolar
board: The most common C1 errors
(Eng ko‘p uchraydigan C1 xatolari)
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda ohang orqali ma’no berishni, bitta gapni hayrat, kinoya yoki ishonch bilan aytishni o‘rgandik. Bugun yangi qoida yo‘q. C1 darajasida xato ko‘pincha bilimdan emas, odatdan keladi: qoidani bilasiz, lekin tez gapirganda eski odat g‘olib chiqadi. Dars oxirida tekshirish ro‘yxati yordamida o‘z matningizdagi xatolarni mustaqil topib tuzata olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last time we explored intonation. Today: no new grammar, just the errors that survive at an advanced level, and a checklist to catch them.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan safar ohangni o‘rgandik. Bugun yangi grammatika yo‘q: faqat ilg‘or darajada saqlanib qoladigan xatolar va ularni tutish uchun tekshirish ro‘yxati.

scenes.title: Birinchi nuqta: he yoki she?
board: u → he / she / it
✗ My sister said he was tired.
✓ My sister said she was tired.

examples.t: My manager is on leave, so she can't reply.
examples.uz: Rahbarim ta’tilda, shuning uchun javob bera olmaydi.

examples.t: I met your brother. He seems very kind.
examples.uz: Akangiz bilan tanishdim. U juda mehribon ko‘rinadi.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi nuqta: ona tilidan ko‘chadigan xatolar. Eng sodda, lekin eng qaysar xato: he va she ni aralashtirish. O‘zbek tilida u erkakka ham, ayolga ham ishlatiladi, shuning uchun tez gapirganda my sister said he was tired chiqib ketadi. Tinglovchi esa he boshqa bir erkak haqida deb o‘ylaydi. His va her ham xuddi shunday aralashadi.
scenes.say: My sister called and said she was exhausted. Mix up he and she, and your listener may think you mean someone else.
scenes.say_uz: Singlim qo‘ng‘iroq qilib, juda charchaganini aytdi. He va she ni aralashtirsangiz, tinglovchi boshqa odamni nazarda tutyapsiz deb o‘ylashi mumkin.

scenes.title: Umumlashtirishda the kerak emas
board: General: Life is short. People are busy.
Specific: The life of a doctor is hard.
✗ The education is important. → ✓ Education is important.

examples.t: Education is the key to a better future.
The education I received was excellent.
examples.uz: Men olgan ta’lim a’lo darajada edi.

scenes.say_native: Artikl xatolarining eng ko‘pi umumlashtirishda. Umuman hayot, odamlar yoki ta’lim haqida gapirganda the qo‘yilmaydi: life is short, people are busy, education is important. Aniq, chegaralangan narsa bo‘lsa, the kerak: the education I received, ya’ni men olgan aynan o‘sha ta’lim. O‘zbek tilida artikl yo‘q, shuning uchun bu farqni ongli ravishda kuzatish kerak.
scenes.say: Education is important. People are busy. But: the education I received was excellent.
scenes.say_uz: Ta’lim muhim. Odamlar band. Lekin: men olgan ta’lim a’lo darajada edi.

scenes.title: Sanalmaydigan otlar
board: information · advice · research · evidence
equipment · furniture · luggage · feedback
a piece of advice · an item of equipment

examples.t: She gave me some useful advice.
We need more evidence before we decide.
examples.uz: Qaror qilishdan oldin bizga ko‘proq dalil kerak.

examples.t: Thank you for your feedback.

scenes.say_native: Yana bir qaysar xato: ingliz tilida sanalmaydigan otlarni ko‘plikka qo‘yish. O‘zbek tilida ma’lumotlar, maslahatlar, tadqiqotlar deymiz, shuning uchun informations, advices, researches degan shakllar chiqadi. Ingliz tilida information, advice, research, evidence, equipment, furniture, luggage va feedback sanalmaydi: ular s olmaydi va a bilan ishlatilmaydi. Bitta maslahat kerak bo‘lsa, a piece of advice deymiz.
scenes.say: She gave me some useful advice. We need more evidence before we decide. Thank you for your feedback. None of these nouns take an s, and none of them take a or an.
scenes.say_uz: U menga foydali maslahat berdi. Qaror qilishdan oldin bizga ko‘proq dalil kerak. Fikr-mulohazangiz uchun rahmat. Bu otlarning hech biri s olmaydi va a yoki an bilan kelmaydi.

scenes.title: Since va for bilan zamon
board: ✗ I live here since 2015.
✓ I have lived / have been living here since 2015.
✗ I am knowing him for years. → ✓ I have known him for years.

examples.t: I have been working here since March.
We have known each other for ten years.

scenes.say_native: Zamon xatolari ham qaysar. O‘zbek va rus tillarida 2015 yildan beri shu yerda yashayman deymiz, hozirgi zamon bilan. Shuning uchun I live here since 2015 chiqadi. Ingliz tilida hozirgacha davom etayotgan holat uchun present perfect yoki present perfect continuous kerak. Know kabi holat fe’llari continuous bo‘lmaydi: I have known him for years.
scenes.say: I have been working here since March. We have known each other for ten years. Not I work here since March.
scenes.say_uz: Martdan beri shu yerda ishlayapman. Bir-birimizni o‘n yildan beri bilamiz. I work here since March emas.

scenes.title: Rus tilidan ko‘chgan tuzilmalar
board: ✗ I am agree. → ✓ I agree.
✗ It depends from you. → ✓ It depends on you.
✗ In our city has many parks. → ✓ There are many parks in our city.

examples.t: There are several reasons for this.

scenes.say_native: Rus tilini yaxshi biladiganlarda yana uchta xato ko‘p uchraydi. Birinchisi, I am agree. Agree fe’l, unga am kerak emas: I agree yoki I don’t agree. Ikkinchisi, depends from, bu rus tilidagi zavisit ot dan ko‘chgan. To‘g‘risi depends on. Uchinchisi, in our city has many parks. Biror joyda nimadir borligini aytish uchun there is yoki there are tuzilmasi ishlatiladi: there are many parks in our city.
scenes.say: I agree, not I am agree. It depends on you, not depends from. And to say that something exists in a place, use there is or there are: there are several reasons for this.
scenes.say_uz: I am agree emas, I agree. Depends from emas, it depends on you. Biror joyda nimadir borligini aytish uchun there is yoki there are ishlating: buning bir necha sababi bor.

scenes.title: Bilvosita savolda so‘z tartibi
board: ✗ Can you tell me where is the station?
✓ Can you tell me where the station is?
✗ I wonder what does she want. → ✓ I wonder what she wants.

examples.t: Do you know what time the meeting starts?

scenes.say_native: C1 darajasida ham ko‘p uchraydigan xato: bilvosita savolda so‘z tartibi. Can you tell me where is the station deyish noto‘g‘ri. Savol so‘zidan keyin oddiy darak gap tartibi keladi: where the station is. Do yordamchi fe’li ham tushib qoladi: I wonder what she wants, what does she want emas.
scenes.say: Not: can you tell me where is the station? But: can you tell me where the station is? After the question word, use normal statement order, and drop do and does.
scenes.say_uz: Can you tell me where is the station emas. To‘g‘risi: can you tell me where the station is. Savol so‘zidan keyin oddiy darak gap tartibini ishlating, do va does ni tushirib qoldiring.

scenes.title: Xatoni toping va tuzating
board: 1) The information you sent were very useful.
2) I work in this company since 2019.
3) My aunt is a doctor and he loves his job.
4) Could you tell me what does this word mean?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Har bir gapda bitta xato bor. Uni toping, nega xato ekanini o‘ylang va to‘g‘ri gapni baland ovozda ayting. Birinchi gapda fe’lga, ikkinchisida zamonga, uchinchisida olmoshlarga, to‘rtinchisida so‘z tartibiga e’tibor bering. Pauzadan keyin javoblarni birga tekshiramiz.
scenes.say: One. The information you sent were very useful. Two. I work in this company since 2019. Three. My aunt is a doctor and he loves his job. Four. Could you tell me what does this word mean?
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Siz yuborgan ma’lumot juda foydali edi. Ikki. Bu kompaniyada 2019 yildan beri ishlayman. Uch. Xolam shifokor va u ishini yaxshi ko‘radi. To‘rt. Bu so‘z nimani anglatishini ayta olasizmi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) The information you sent was very useful.
2) I have worked / have been working for this company since 2019.
3) …and she loves her job.
4) Could you tell me what this word means?
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: information sanalmaydi, shuning uchun was. Ikkinchi: since bilan present perfect kerak: I have been working here since 2019. Kompaniya bilan for this company yanada tabiiy. Uchinchi: xola ayol kishi, demak she loves her job, ikki olmosh birdaniga tuzatiladi. To‘rtinchi: could you tell me what this word means, does tushadi va s fe’lga o‘tadi.
scenes.say: The information you sent was very useful. I have been working for this company since 2019. My aunt is a doctor and she loves her job. Could you tell me what this word means?
scenes.say_uz: Siz yuborgan ma’lumot juda foydali edi. 2019 yildan beri bu kompaniyada ishlab kelyapman. Xolam shifokor va u ishini yaxshi ko‘radi. Bu so‘z nimani anglatishini ayta olasizmi?

scenes.title: Ikkinchi nuqta: hamroh so‘zlar
board: Collocation = words that naturally go together
make a decision · do research
draw a conclusion · meet a deadline
✗ do a mistake → ✓ make a mistake

examples.t: We need to make a decision by Friday.
examples.uz: Juma kunigacha qaror qabul qilishimiz kerak.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi nuqta: hamroh so‘zlar va predloglar. Collocation bu tabiiy ravishda birga keladigan so‘zlar. Do a mistake grammatik jihatdan to‘g‘ri, lekin ravon so‘zlovchi make a mistake deydi. Qaror qabul qilmoq esa make a decision. C1 darajasida yana shu juftliklar kutiladi: meet a deadline, draw a conclusion, raise a question, make progress. Ularni butun birikma sifatida yodlang.
scenes.say: Do a mistake is grammatical, but no fluent speaker would say it. We make a mistake, make a decision, and do research.
scenes.say_uz: Do a mistake grammatik jihatdan to‘g‘ri, lekin ravon so‘zlovchi buni aytmaydi. Make a mistake, make a decision va do research deymiz.

scenes.title: Predlogsiz fe’llar
board: discuss sth (✗ discuss about)
enter a room · marry sb · lack sth
explain sth to sb (✗ explain me)

examples.t: We discussed the budget at length.
Could you explain the process to me?

scenes.say_native: Ba’zi fe’llar to‘g‘ridan to‘g‘ri to‘ldiruvchi oladi, predlog kerak emas. Discuss the problem, discuss about emas, chunki discuss ning ichida haqida ma’nosi bor. Enter the room, enter into the room emas. Marry someone, lack confidence. Explain bilan esa teskari muammo: explain me xato, kimga tushuntirishni to bilan beramiz: explain the process to me. O‘zbekcha haqida va rus tilidagi o dan ta’sirlanmang.
scenes.say: We discussed the budget at length. He lacks experience. Could you explain the process to me?
scenes.say_uz: Byudjetni batafsil muhokama qildik. Unga tajriba yetishmaydi. Jarayonni menga tushuntirib bera olasizmi?

scenes.title: Bog‘liq predloglar
board: depend on · rely on · insist on · consist of
responsible for · interested in · married to
reason for · solution to · impact on · increase in

examples.t: Who is responsible for the delay?
There has been a sharp increase in prices.
We need a solution to this problem.

scenes.say_native: Endi predlogi qat’iy bo‘lgan so‘zlar. Fe’llar: depend on, rely on, insist on, consist of. Sifatlar: responsible for, interested in, married to. Otlar: reason for, solution to, impact on, increase in. Increase in prices narxlardagi o‘sish, increase of ten percent esa o‘sish miqdori. Bu predloglarni mantiq bilan topib bo‘lmaydi, so‘z bilan birga yodlanadi.
scenes.say: Who is responsible for the delay? There has been a sharp increase in prices, an increase of ten percent. We need a solution to this problem, not a solution of it.
scenes.say_uz: Kechikish uchun kim javobgar? Narxlarda keskin o‘sish bo‘ldi, o‘n foizlik o‘sish. Bu muammoga yechim kerak.

scenes.title: Predlog xatolari
board: ✗ She is married with a lawyer. → ✓ married to
✗ the reason of the failure → ✓ the reason for
✗ arrive to London → ✓ arrive in London / at the airport
scenes.say_native: Uchta tipik xato. Married with a lawyer emas, married to a lawyer; bu o‘zbekcha bilan turmush qurgan iborasidan ko‘chadi. The reason of emas, the reason for. Arrive to London ham xato: shahar yoki mamlakat uchun arrive in, bino yoki aeroport uchun arrive at. Go to va get to bilan to keladi, shuning uchun arrive bilan aralashib ketadi.
scenes.say: She is married to a lawyer. What was the reason for the failure? We arrived in London at midnight and at the hotel half an hour later.
scenes.say_uz: U advokatga turmushga chiqqan. Muvaffaqiyatsizlik sababi nima edi? Londonga yarim tunda, mehmonxonaga esa yarim soatdan keyin yetib keldik.

scenes.title: Predlogni qo‘ying
board: 1) The result depends ___ the weather.
2) The course consists ___ six modules.
3) This will have a huge impact ___ sales.
4) We discussed ___ the plan. (anything?)
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Bo‘sh joyga mos predlogni qo‘ying. Ehtiyot bo‘ling: bitta gapda predlog umuman kerak emas bo‘lishi mumkin. Bu predloglarni mantiq bilan emas, xotira bilan topasiz, shuning uchun birinchi kelgan variantga shoshmang. Har bir gapni to‘liq ayting. Pauzadan keyin javoblarni ko‘ramiz.
scenes.say: One. The result depends, blank, the weather. Two. The course consists, blank, six modules. Three. This will have a huge impact, blank, sales. Four. We discussed, blank, the plan.
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Natija ob-havoga bog‘liq. Ikki. Kurs olti moduldan iborat. Uch. Bu sotuvlarga katta ta’sir qiladi. To‘rt. Rejani muhokama qildik.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) depends on
2) consists of
3) an impact on
4) discussed the plan (no preposition)
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: depends on the weather. Ikkinchi: consists of six modules, from emas. Uchinchi: a huge impact on sales, xuddi effect on kabi. To‘rtinchi: hech qanday predlog kerak emas, we discussed the plan. Agar to‘rtinchida about qo‘ygan bo‘lsangiz, bu aynan biz gaplashgan qaysar xato. Uni xatolar daftaringizga yozib qo‘ying.
scenes.say: The result depends on the weather. The course consists of six modules. This will have a huge impact on sales. We discussed the plan, with no preposition at all.
scenes.say_uz: Natija ob-havoga bog‘liq. Kurs olti moduldan iborat. Bu sotuvlarga katta ta’sir qiladi. Rejani muhokama qildik, hech qanday predlogsiz.

scenes.title: Sifat va kuchaytiruvchi juftliklar
board: heavy rain · heavy traffic · a heavy smoker
strong coffee · strong wind · high prices
highly unlikely · bitterly disappointed · deeply concerned

examples.t: Traffic was unusually heavy this morning.
examples.uz: Bugun ertalab tirbandlik odatdagidan kuchli edi.

examples.t: It is highly unlikely that they will agree.

scenes.say_native: Sifat va ot juftliklarida tarjima eng ko‘p pand beradi. O‘zbekcha kuchli yomg‘ir, rus tilida silniy dojd, lekin ingliz tilida heavy rain va heavy traffic. Kuchli qahva esa strong coffee, baland narxlar high prices, expensive prices emas. Kuchaytiruvchilar ham tanlab keladi: highly unlikely, bitterly disappointed, deeply concerned.
scenes.say: Traffic was unusually heavy this morning. Prices are high; goods are expensive. And it's highly unlikely that they'll agree.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun ertalab tirbandlik odatdagidan kuchli edi. Narxlar high, tovarlar esa expensive bo‘ladi. Ularning rozi bo‘lishi juda dargumon.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri juftlikni tanlang
board: 1) a (strong / heavy) smoker
2) (do / make) progress
3) (bitterly / strongly) disappointed
4) (make / draw) a conclusion
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Har bir juftlikda tabiiy eshitiladigan variantni tanlang va u bilan qisqa gap tuzing. Masalan, birinchisi uchun: my grandfather was a heavy smoker kabi. Tarjima qilib emas, qaysi birikma quloqqa tanish eshitilishiga qarab tanlang. Gaplaringizni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Choose the natural collocation. One. A strong or a heavy smoker. Two. Do or make progress. Three. Bitterly or strongly disappointed. Four. Make or draw a conclusion.
scenes.say_uz: Tabiiy birikmani tanlang. Bir. Strong yoki heavy smoker. Ikki. Do yoki make progress. Uch. Bitterly yoki strongly disappointed. To‘rt. Make yoki draw a conclusion.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) a heavy smoker
2) make progress
3) bitterly disappointed
4) draw a conclusion

examples.t: She has made remarkable progress this year.
examples.uz: U bu yil ajoyib natijaga erishdi.

scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: a heavy smoker, ko‘p chekadigan odam. Ikkinchi: make progress, va eslatma, progress sanalmaydi, a progress demaymiz. Uchinchi: bitterly disappointed, qattiq hafsalasi pir bo‘lgan. Strongly ko‘proq fikr bilan keladi: I strongly disagree, I strongly believe. To‘rtinchi: draw a conclusion. Make a conclusion ni ko‘p eshitasiz, lekin u tabiiy emas.
scenes.say: A heavy smoker. She has made remarkable progress. I was bitterly disappointed. Draw a conclusion.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘p chekadigan odam. U ajoyib natijaga erishdi. Hafsalam qattiq pir bo‘ldi. Xulosa chiqarmoq.

scenes.title: Tinglash: hisobot tahriri
board: Nodira: Could you look over my report?
James: You've written 'discuss about' twice.
James: And 'researches' has no plural.
scenes.say_native: Endi dialogni tinglang. Nodira xalqaro kompaniyada ishlaydi va hisobotini topshirishdan oldin hamkasbi James dan ko‘rib chiqishni so‘raydi. James qaysi xatolarni topganiga va Nodira qanday reaksiya bildirganiga e’tibor bering. Keyin uchta savolga javob berasiz.
scenes.say: Nodira: James, could you look over my report before I send it? James: Sure. It reads well, but you've written discuss about twice. Just discuss the results. Nodira: Oh, I always do that! James: And researches here should be research, no s. Also, you've called the CFO he, but Laura's a woman. Nodira: That's embarrassing. James: Not at all. Everything else is spot on, and the conclusions are very convincing.
scenes.say_uz: Nodira: James, yuborishdan oldin hisobotimni ko‘rib chiqa olasizmi? James: Albatta. Yaxshi o‘qiladi, lekin ikki marta discuss about deb yozibsiz. Shunchaki discuss the results. Nodira: Voy, doim shunday qilaman! James: Bu yerda researches o‘rniga research, s siz. Moliya direktorini he deb atabsiz, lekin Laura ayol kishi. Nodira: Uyat bo‘ldi. James: Aslo. Qolgani juda to‘g‘ri, xulosalar juda ishonarli.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 1) How many errors does James point out?
2) Which one is a pronoun error?
3) What does James say about the rest of the report?
scenes.say_native: Dialog bo‘yicha uchta savol. Birinchi: James nechta xatoni ko‘rsatdi? Ikkinchi: ulardan qaysi biri olmosh bilan bog‘liq va nega? Uchinchi: hisobotning qolgan qismi haqida James nima deydi? Javoblarni inglizcha to‘liq gap bilan bering, kerak bo‘lsa dialogni qayta eshiting.
scenes.say: Question one. How many errors does James point out? Question two. Which one is a pronoun error, and why? Question three. What does James say about the rest of the report?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi savol. James nechta xatoni ko‘rsatadi? Ikkinchi savol. Qaysi biri olmosh xatosi va nega? Uchinchi savol. James hisobotning qolgan qismi haqida nima deydi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Three: discuss about, researches, he for Laura
2) 'he' → 'she', because Laura is a woman
3) Spot on; the conclusions are convincing
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: uchta xato, discuss about, researches va moliya direktorini he deb atash. Ikkinchi: olmosh xatosi, chunki Laura ayol, demak she bo‘lishi kerak. Uchinchi: qolgan qismi spot on, ya’ni juda aniq, xulosalar ishonarli. E’tibor bering, uchala xato ham bugun ko‘rgan qaysar xatolar. Spot on iborasi esa norasmiy, lekin hamkasblar orasida juda tabiiy.
scenes.say: James spots three errors, and says the rest is spot on, meaning exactly right.
scenes.say_uz: James uchta xatoni topadi va qolgani spot on, ya’ni mutlaqo to‘g‘ri ekanini aytadi.

scenes.title: Uchinchi nuqta: uslubiy chalkashlik
board: Register = level of formality
informal · neutral · formal
Slip = the wrong level for the situation
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi nuqta: uslubiy chalkashlik, ya’ni register slip. Register bu nutqning rasmiylik darajasi. Grammatika to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa ham, uslub mos kelmasa, matn g‘alati eshitiladi: rasmiy xatda kids yoki gonna, do‘stga xabarda esa I shall endeavour. Suhbatda I’ll try to get the tickets yoki I’ll sort it out deyish mutlaqo tabiiy, kitobiy so‘zlar u yerda sovuq eshitiladi.
scenes.say: A register slip is when the grammar is fine but the tone is wrong: gonna in a formal letter, or I shall endeavour in a text to a friend.
scenes.say_uz: Register slip grammatika to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa-yu, ohang noto‘g‘ri bo‘lganda yuz beradi: rasmiy xatda gonna yoki do‘stga xabarda I shall endeavour.

scenes.title: Rasmiy matnda norasmiy so‘zlar
board: a lot of → a great deal of (uncount.) / numerous (count.)
kids → children · get → obtain · stuff → material
can't → cannot · really big → substantial

examples.t: A great deal of money has been invested.
Numerous studies have confirmed this.

scenes.say_native: Insho yoki rasmiy hisobotda eng ko‘p uchraydigan slip: og‘zaki so‘zlar. A lot of o‘rniga a great deal of, lekin faqat sanalmaydigan ot bilan: a great deal of money. Sanaladigan ot bilan numerous yoki a large number of: numerous studies. Kids o‘rniga children, stuff o‘rniga material, really big o‘rniga substantial. Qisqartmalar ham, ya’ni can’t va don’t, rasmiy insholarda odatda to‘liq yoziladi.
scenes.say: A great deal of money has been invested, and numerous studies have confirmed the benefits.
scenes.say_uz: Katta miqdorda pul sarmoya qilingan va ko‘plab tadqiqotlar foydasini tasdiqlagan.

scenes.title: Rasmiy xatdagi kalkalar
board: ✗ Respected Mr Karimov → ✓ Dear Mr Karimov
✗ Give me the information. → ✓ Could you let me know…?
✗ I want to ask… → ✓ I would like to ask…

examples.t: Could you let me know when the documents are ready?
examples.uz: Hujjatlar qachon tayyor bo‘lishini menga xabar bera olasizmi?

scenes.say_native: Rasmiy xatlarda o‘zbek tilidan ko‘chgan kalkalar ko‘p. Hurmatli so‘zini respected deb tarjima qilish xato, ingliz tilida rasmiy xat ham Dear bilan boshlanadi: Dear Mr Karimov. Buyruq maylini to‘g‘ridan to‘g‘ri ko‘chirish ham qo‘pol eshitiladi: give me the information emas, could you let me know. I want o‘rniga I would like. Xatni yakunlashda Kind regards yoki Yours sincerely, Cheers esa faqat do‘stona xatda.
scenes.say: Dear Mr Karimov, could you let me know when the documents will be ready? I would like to submit them by Friday. Kind regards.
scenes.say_uz: Hurmatli janob Karimov, hujjatlar qachon tayyor bo‘lishini menga xabar bera olasizmi? Ularni jumagacha topshirmoqchiman. Hurmat bilan.

scenes.title: Uslub xatolari
board: ✗ So, kids today use phones a lot. (essay)
✓ Children today spend a considerable amount of time on their phones.
✗ Everybody knows that… → ✓ It is widely believed that…
scenes.say_native: Inshodagi tipik slip. So, kids today use phones a lot gapida uch muammo bor: so bilan boshlash og‘zaki odat, kids norasmiy, a lot esa noaniq. Yaxshiroq: children today spend a considerable amount of time on their phones. Everybody knows that ham xato, chunki akademik matnda dalilsiz eshitiladi. Uni it is widely believed that bilan yumshatamiz.
scenes.say: Not: so, kids today use phones a lot. Better: children today spend a considerable amount of time on their phones.
scenes.say_uz: So, kids today use phones a lot emas. Yaxshiroq: bugungi bolalar telefonlarida ancha ko‘p vaqt o‘tkazadi.

scenes.title: Rasmiy uslubga o‘tkazing
board: 1) Lots of people think it's a bad idea. (essay)
2) Send me the report ASAP. (email to a client)
3) The government should do something about it. (report)
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Uchta gapni rasmiy uslubga o‘tkazing. Birinchisi inshoda, ikkinchisi mijozga yoziladigan xatda, uchinchisi rasmiy hisobotda. So‘z tanlashga, qisqartmalarga va buyruq ohangiga e’tibor bering. Bitta to‘g‘ri javob yo‘q, bir nechta variant mumkin. O‘z variantingizni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Make these more formal. One, in an essay: lots of people think it's a bad idea. Two, in an email to a client: send me the report ASAP. Three, in a report: the government should do something about it.
scenes.say_uz: Bularni rasmiyroq qiling. Bir, inshoda: ko‘p odamlar buni yomon fikr deb o‘ylaydi. Ikki, mijozga xatda: hisobotni tezroq yuboring. Uch, hisobotda: hukumat bu borada biror narsa qilishi kerak.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javoblar
board: 1) Many people consider it an unwise decision.
2) Could you send me the report at your earliest convenience?
3) The government should take action to address the issue.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. Birinchi: many people consider it an unwise decision. Lots of many ga, think consider ga, bad idea esa unwise decision ga almashdi. Ikkinchi: could you send me the report at your earliest convenience. Buyruq so‘rovga aylandi, ASAP esa rasmiy iboraga. Uchinchi: the government should take action to address the issue. Do something noaniq, take action va address the issue aniq va rasmiy.
scenes.say: Many people consider it an unwise decision. Could you send me the report at your earliest convenience? The government should take action to address the issue.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘pchilik buni oqilona bo‘lmagan qaror deb hisoblaydi. Hisobotni imkon qadar tezroq yubora olasizmi? Hukumat muammoni hal qilish uchun choralar ko‘rishi kerak.

scenes.title: Tinglash: tutor bilan suhbat
board: Tutor: Your argument is strong, but the tone wobbles.
Student: You mean it's too chatty?
Tutor: In places. And watch 'everybody knows'.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Talaba Aziz tutor bilan inshosi haqida gaplashmoqda. Tutor uning g‘oyalarini maqtaydi, lekin uslub bilan bog‘liq ikkita muammoni ko‘rsatadi. Bu suhbat ham, tutorning tanqidi ham juda tipik. Qaysi so‘z va iboralar muammo ekaniga, tutor nimani taklif qilishiga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Tutor: Your argument is strong, Aziz, but the tone wobbles. Aziz: You mean it's too chatty? Tutor: In places. You open the second paragraph with anyway, and you say kids three times. Aziz: Right. Children, then. Tutor: Yes. And the bigger issue is everybody knows that. You can't prove that. Try many researchers argue that, and then cite one. Aziz: Got it. Hedge it, and back it up.
scenes.say_uz: Tutor: Aziz, dalilingiz kuchli, lekin ohang chayqaladi. Aziz: Juda gapdonmi demoqchisiz? Tutor: Ba’zi joylarda. Ikkinchi xatboshini anyway bilan boshlagansiz, kids ni uch marta ishlatgansiz. Aziz: Tushundim. Demak, children. Tutor: Ha. Kattaroq muammo everybody knows that. Buni isbotlay olmaysiz. Many researchers argue that deb yozing va bittasiga havola bering. Aziz: Tushundim. Yumshatish va dalil keltirish.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 1) What does the tutor praise?
2) Which two informal words are mentioned?
3) What should replace 'everybody knows that'?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: tutor nimani maqtaydi? Ikkinchi: qaysi ikkita norasmiy so‘z tilga olindi? Uchinchi: everybody knows that o‘rniga nima yozish kerak va undan keyin nima qilish lozim? Javoblaringizni qisqa, lekin to‘liq inglizcha gap bilan bering.
scenes.say: One. What does the tutor praise? Two. Which two informal words does the tutor mention? Three. What should replace everybody knows that, and what should Aziz do next?
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Tutor nimani maqtaydi? Ikki. Tutor qaysi ikkita norasmiy so‘zni tilga oladi? Uch. Everybody knows that o‘rniga nima yozish kerak va Aziz keyin nima qilishi kerak?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) The argument is strong
2) 'anyway' and 'kids'
3) 'Many researchers argue that…' + cite a source
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: tutor dalilni, ya’ni argumentni maqtaydi. Ikkinchi: anyway va kids. Uchinchi: many researchers argue that deb yozish va keyin bitta manbaga havola berish. Aziz buni ikki so‘z bilan xulosa qiladi: hedge it and back it up, ya’ni da’voni yumshatish va dalil bilan quvvatlash. Tutorning chatty so‘ziga ham e’tibor bering: bu juda gapdon, suhbat ohangidagi degani.
scenes.say: The tutor praises the argument. The informal words are anyway and kids. Aziz should hedge the claim and cite a source.
scenes.say_uz: Tutor dalilni maqtaydi. Norasmiy so‘zlar anyway va kids. Aziz da’voni yumshatib, manbaga havola berishi kerak.

scenes.title: Talaffuzdagi qaysar xatolar
board: /v/ very · /w/ well — lips!
deVELopment · eCONomy · phoTOGrapher
comfortable /ˈkʌmftəbl/ · Wednesday /ˈwenzdeɪ/
scenes.say_native: Talaffuzda ham qaysar xatolar bor. Birinchisi v va w: o‘zbek tilida v ko‘pincha ikki lab bilan aytiladi, shuning uchun very va well yaqinlashadi. Ingliz tilida v da yuqori tishlar pastki labga tegadi, w da lablar dumaloqlanadi. Ikkinchisi urg‘u: development, economy, photographer, ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda. Uchinchisi o‘qilmaydigan harflar: Wednesday ikki bo‘g‘in.
scenes.say: Very well. A village with a view. Development, economy, photographer. Comfortable has three syllables, and Wednesday has two.
scenes.say_uz: Very well. Manzarali qishloq. Development, economy, photographer. Comfortable da uch bo‘g‘in, Wednesday da ikki bo‘g‘in bor.

scenes.title: Ovoz chiqarib takrorlang
board: We visited a very wet village on Wednesday.
The development of the economy was slow.
The photographer felt very comfortable.
scenes.say_native: Takrorlang. Birinchi gapda v va w ni farqlang: v da tish labga tegadi, w da lablar oldinga cho‘ziladi. Ikkinchi va uchinchi gapda urg‘uli bo‘g‘inni kuchliroq va uzunroq ayting. Har bir gapni ikki marta ayting, ikkinchisida tezroq, lekin tovushlarni buzmasdan.
scenes.say: We visited a very wet village on Wednesday. The development of the economy was slow. The photographer felt very comfortable.
scenes.say_uz: Chorshanba kuni juda nam qishloqqa bordik. Iqtisodiyotning rivojlanishi sekin edi. Fotograf o‘zini juda qulay his qildi.

scenes.title: Tekshiramiz
board: /w/ we · wet · Wednesday
/v/ visited · very · village
deVELopment · eCONomy · phoTOGrapher · COMFtable
scenes.say_native: O‘zingizni tekshiring. W bilan: we, wet, Wednesday. V bilan: visited, very, village. Agar very wet ni aytayotganda lablaringiz ikki xil holatda bo‘lmagan bo‘lsa, ko‘zgu oldida sekin mashq qiling. Urg‘u: development da vel, economy da con, photographer da tog, comfortable da birinchi bo‘g‘in comf. Photograph so‘zida esa urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda.
scenes.say: We, wet, Wednesday. Visited, very, village. Development, economy, photographer. But notice: photograph is stressed on the first syllable, and photographer on the second.
scenes.say_uz: We, wet, Wednesday. Visited, very, village. Development, economy, photographer. Lekin e’tibor bering: photograph da urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda, photographer da ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda.

scenes.title: To‘rtinchi nuqta: o‘z matningizni tahrirlash
board: One read = you see what you meant
Several passes = you see what you wrote
One pass → one type of error
scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi nuqta: o‘z matningizni tahrir qilish. Matnni bir marta o‘qisangiz, miya yozganingizni emas, yozmoqchi bo‘lganingizni ko‘radi va xatolarni avtomatik to‘g‘rilab o‘qiydi. Shuning uchun professional muharrirlar matnni bir necha marta, har safar bitta turdagi xatoni qidirib o‘qiydi. Bir o‘qishda fe’llarni, keyingisida artikl va otlarni, yana birida predloglarni tekshirasiz.
scenes.say: When you reread your own writing once, you see what you meant, not what you wrote. Editors read in several passes, each looking for one type of error only.
scenes.say_uz: O‘z matningizni bir marta qayta o‘qiganingizda yozganingizni emas, nazarda tutganingizni ko‘rasiz. Muharrirlar matnni bir necha marta o‘qiydi, har safar faqat bitta turdagi xatoni qidiradi.

scenes.title: Tekshirish ro‘yxati
board: 1 Verbs: tense, since/for, agreement
2 Nouns: articles, uncountables, he/she
3 Words: collocations, prepositions
4 Register: formal enough? hedged?
scenes.say_native: Mana tekshirish ro‘yxatingiz. Birinchi o‘qish, fe’llar: zamon, since va for, ega va kesim mosligi. Ikkinchi, otlar: artikllar, sanalmaydigan otlar, he va she. Uchinchi, so‘zlar: hamroh so‘zlar va predloglar. To‘rtinchi, uslub: matn vaziyatga mosmi, kuchli da’volar yumshatilganmi. Topgan xatolaringizni xatolar daftariga yozib boring.
scenes.say: Pass one: verbs. Pass two: nouns, articles and pronouns. Pass three: collocations and prepositions. Pass four: register.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi o‘qish: fe’llar. Ikkinchi: otlar, artikllar va olmoshlar. Uchinchi: hamroh so‘zlar va predloglar. To‘rtinchi: uslub.

scenes.title: Tahrirdagi xatolar
board: ✗ Relying only on a spellchecker
✗ Fixing everything in one reading
✓ form/from · their/there → check yourself
scenes.say_native: Tahrir jarayonidagi ikki xato. Birinchisi, faqat avtomatik imlo tekshiruviga ishonish. U from o‘rniga yozilgan form ni yoki there o‘rniga their ni ko‘pincha sezmaydi, chunki ikkalasi ham haqiqiy so‘z. Ikkinchisi, hamma narsani bir o‘qishda tuzatishga urinish. Imtihonda vaqt kam, shuning uchun o‘zingizning eng ko‘p takrorlanadigan xatolaringizga e’tibor qarating.
scenes.say: A spellchecker won't notice form instead of from, or their instead of there, because both are real words.
scenes.say_uz: Imlo tekshiruvchi from o‘rniga form yoki there o‘rniga their ni sezmaydi, chunki ikkalasi ham haqiqiy so‘z.

scenes.title: Matnni tahrir qiling
board: Dear Mr Brown, I am agree with your proposal.
We discussed about it and made a research.
The results depends from the budget.
Our manager said he is ready. (manager = Ms Lee)
scenes.say_native: Endi yakuniy ijodiy topshiriq. Ekrandagi qisqa xatda oltita xato bor. Tekshirish ro‘yxatidan foydalanib, ularni toping va xatni to‘g‘ri shaklda baland ovozda o‘qing. Eslatma: menejer Ms Lee, ya’ni ayol kishi. Shoshilmang, har bir qatorni alohida tekshiring.
scenes.say: Edit this short email. There are six errors. Dear Mr Brown, I am agree with your proposal. We discussed about it and made a research. The results depends from the budget. Our manager said he is ready.
scenes.say_uz: Bu qisqa xatni tahrir qiling. Oltita xato bor. Hurmatli janob Braun, taklifingizga qo‘shilaman. Biz uni muhokama qildik va tadqiqot o‘tkazdik. Natijalar byudjetga bog‘liq. Menejerimiz tayyor ekanini aytdi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: I agree with your proposal.
We discussed it and carried out some research.
The results depend on the budget.
Our manager said she was ready.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: am kerak emas, I agree. Ikkinchi: discussed it, about siz. Uchinchi: made a research o‘rniga carried out some research, research sanalmaydi va make bilan kelmaydi. To‘rtinchi va beshinchi: results ko‘plikda, demak depend, va from emas, on. Oltinchi: Ms Lee ayol, demak she. Said dan keyin was ham tabiiy, lekin u hali ham tayyor bo‘lsa, is ham noto‘g‘ri emas.
scenes.say: Dear Mr Brown, I agree with your proposal. We discussed it and carried out some research. The results depend on the budget. Our manager said she was ready.
scenes.say_uz: Hurmatli janob Braun, taklifingizga qo‘shilaman. Biz uni muhokama qildik va biroz tadqiqot o‘tkazdik. Natijalar byudjetga bog‘liq. Menejerimiz tayyor ekanini aytdi.

scenes.title: O‘zingiz yozing
board: Write 4 sentences: your job or studies
Use: since · advice/information · depend on · a collocation
Then run the 4-pass checklist
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz yozing. Ishingiz yoki o‘qishingiz haqida to‘rtta gap tuzing. Unda since, advice yoki information, depend on va bugungi hamroh so‘zlardan biri bo‘lsin. Keyin to‘rt bosqichli ro‘yxat bilan tekshiring. Yozish imkoni bo‘lmasa, gaplarni ovoz chiqarib ayting.
scenes.say: Write four sentences about your work or studies. Use since, the word advice or information, depend on, and one collocation from today. Then check them with the four-pass list.
scenes.say_uz: Ishingiz yoki o‘qishingiz haqida to‘rtta gap yozing. Since, advice yoki information, depend on va bugungi birikmalardan birini ishlating. So‘ng to‘rt bosqichli ro‘yxat bilan tekshiring.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: I have been studying English since 2020.
My teacher gave me some useful advice.
My progress depends on regular practice.
I always try to meet my deadlines.
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna. I have been studying English since 2020: present perfect continuous. My teacher gave me some useful advice: advice s siz. My progress depends on regular practice: depends on, ega birlikda, demak s. I always try to meet my deadlines: hamroh so‘z. Sizning gaplaringiz boshqacha bo‘ladi, muhimi ro‘yxatdagi to‘rt bosqichni bajarganingiz.
scenes.say: I have been studying English since 2020. My teacher gave me some useful advice. My progress depends on regular practice, and I always try to meet my deadlines.
scenes.say_uz: 2020 yildan beri ingliz tilini o‘rganib kelyapman. Ustozim menga foydali maslahat berdi. Rivojlanishim muntazam mashqqa bog‘liq va men doim muddatlarga ulgurishga harakat qilaman.

scenes.title: Qisqa takrorlash
board: 1 L1 errors: he/she, the, uncountables, since
2 Collocations + prepositions
3 Register: not too chatty, not too stiff
4 Self-edit in four passes
scenes.say_native: Takrorlaymiz. Birinchi: ona tilidan kelgan xatolar, he va she, umumlashtirishda the yo‘qligi, sanalmaydigan otlar, since bilan present perfect, I agree va there are. Ikkinchi: hamroh so‘zlar va predloglar, discuss about emas, make a decision, depend on. Uchinchi: uslub, rasmiy matnda kids va so emas, suhbatda esa haddan tashqari rasmiylik emas. To‘rtinchi: matnni to‘rt bosqichda tekshirish.
scenes.say: Watch for transfer errors, learn words with their partners, match your register, and edit in four passes.
scenes.say_uz: Ona tilidan ko‘chgan xatolardan ehtiyot bo‘ling, so‘zlarni hamrohlari bilan o‘rganing, uslubni moslang va to‘rt bosqichda tahrir qiling.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Homework: find and fix 15 errors in a text
Label each: verb · noun · word · register
Success: 13+ found and correctly explained
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: o‘n beshta xatosi bor matnni, masalan o‘zingizning eski inshongizni, oling va barcha xatolarni topib tuzating. Har biriga belgi qo‘ying: fe’l, ot, so‘z yoki uslub. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida o‘n uchta xatoni topib, nega xato ekanini tushuntira olish. Keyingi darsda imtihonda vaqt va stressni boshqarishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: For homework, find and fix fifteen errors in a text, and label each one. Next time: managing time and stress in exams.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: matndagi o‘n beshta xatoni topib tuzating va har birini belgilang. Keyingi safar: imtihonda vaqt va stressni boshqarish.

homework_uz: O‘n beshta xatosi bor matnni oling (eski inshongiz yoki berilgan matn) va barcha xatolarni topib tuzating. Har bir xatoni fe’l, ot, so‘z tanlash yoki uslub xatosi deb belgilang. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida 13 ta xatoni topib, nega xato ekanini tushuntira olish. Eng ko‘p takrorlangan uchta xatoni xatolar daftaringizga yozing.

options: She gave me many useful advices.
She gave me a useful advice.
She gave me some useful advice.
She gave me an useful advices.
quiz.why_uz: Advice sanalmaydi: s olmaydi va a bilan kelmaydi. Some advice yoki a piece of advice deymiz.

options: I have lived in Tashkent since 2018.
I am living in Tashkent since 2018.
quiz.why_uz: Hozirgacha davom etayotgan holat since bilan present perfect talab qiladi.

quiz.q: Complete: 'We need to ___ the problem at the next meeting.'
quiz.why_uz: Discuss to‘g‘ridan to‘g‘ri to‘ldiruvchi oladi, about kerak emas.

options: Can you tell me where is the library?
Can you tell me where the library is?
Can you tell me where does the library is?
Can you tell me where is it the library?
quiz.why_uz: Bilvosita savolda so‘z tartibi darak gapdagidek: where the library is.

quiz.q: My boss, Mrs Aliyeva, called. ___ wants the figures by noon.
quiz.why_uz: Mrs Aliyeva ayol kishi, shuning uchun she. O‘zbekcha u ikkala jins uchun ishlatilgani sababli bu xato tez-tez uchraydi.
Make a decision va draw a conclusion tabiiy birikmalar.
Married to deymiz. Married with rus va o‘zbek tilidan ko‘chgan xato.

quiz.q: Which is best in a formal essay?
options: Kids these days use phones a lot.
Children today spend a considerable amount of time on their phones.
Everybody knows kids are always on their phones.
quiz.why_uz: Rasmiy inshoda kids, so, a lot, loads va everybody knows kabi og‘zaki iboralar o‘rniga neytral-rasmiy so‘zlar ishlatiladi.

quiz.q: Which opening is correct for a formal email?
quiz.why_uz: Ingliz tilida rasmiy xat ham Dear bilan boshlanadi. Respected o‘zbekcha hurmatli so‘zining kalkasi.

quiz.q: Why is reading your text in several passes better than reading it once?
options: You only need to check spelling.
Each pass focuses on one type of error, so fewer errors are missed.
quiz.why_uz: Bir o‘qishda miya xatolarni avtomatik to‘g‘rilab o‘qiydi. Har bosqichda bitta xato turini qidirish samaraliroq.
